evidence.name: 论文摘要页
evidence.text:
Abstract
We examine whether early exposure to air pollution affects cognitive test scores in a cohort of 12,000 students across 84 schools. Using a regression discontinuity design around a district heating plant, we find a 1.8 point reduction in standardised maths scores per 10 µg/m³ increase in PM2.5, with effects concentrated among younger students. The estimates are robust to alternative specifications and to the inclusion of school fixed effects.
